title: Shortest Street Name
description: Found by number of letters on the sign (e.g., 'Park Street' = 10). No phones allowed to search. Tie goes to the first submission.

title: Most Expensive Souvenir
description: Highest dollar amount on a price tag. Must reference Boston, MA, or a directly associated entity (like a sports team).

title: Most Distant License Plate
description: Measured from the plate location to the nearest point in the territory. Tie goes to the first found.

title: Photograph the Most Birds
description: Each bird counts once. Photos can contain multiple birds. Most birds total wins.

title: Find the Oldest Thing
description: Age counts as the youngest possible within a verified range. Phones allowed for verification only, not locating.

title: Find the Longest Book
description: Verified by page count. Books found outside bookstores or libraries count double!

title: Find the Smallest Park
description: Must be public and labeled 'park' or 'garden' on Google Maps. Area includes the whole plot.

title: Find the Shortest Street
description: Determined by physical distance. No phones allowed. Must be a road, not a driveway or alley.

title: Photograph Most Cyclists
description: Each cyclist counts once. Photos can contain multiple cyclists. Most total wins.

title: Most Unique Flags
description: Find and photograph the highest number of unique flags representing anything.

title: Find the Highest Number
description: Must be a single number (license plate digits allowed). Cannot use items you brought with you.

title: Find the oldest food
description: The team that has found the food longest past its listed expiration date after 15 minutes wins.  Tie goes to the team that sends theirs first

title: Find the most languaged
description: The text may not be in a book or from your phone, but can be on any other printed material (e.g. a menu) or display (e.g. a billboard).

title: Find the worst place
description: The team at the place with the worst Google Maps rating after 15 minutes wins.  Teams may not check the ratings until they lock in their place.  Tie goes to the place with the most ratings.

title: Flag Race
description: The first team to touch a flagpole flying the USA or Massachusetts flag wins the battle immediately.

title: Exit Civilization
description: First pair to verifiably get 500 meters away from a bus stop wins the battle immediately.

title: Lock a Door
description: First player to lock a door (in the vicinity of teammates) wins the battle immediately.

title: Photograph a Dog
description: First player to photograph a dog (in the presence of their pair) wins the battle immediately.

title: Stack 7 Rocks
description: First team to stack 7 rocks that stand for at least 10 seconds wins the battle immediately.

title: Neighborhood Tripoint
description: First pair to reach a point where three neighborhoods meet wins. Roll new battle if no tripoint exists here.

title: Go to a Church
description: First pair to touch a church wins the battle immediately.

title: Ascend 50 Stairs
description: First pair to each ascend 50 stairs wins. Each stair only counts once per teammate.
